title: CAST: Critique-Aware Supervision for Training Reliable Long-Horizon Tool-Calling Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.30147v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in long-horizon, interactive, and stateful environments. In these settings, a single wrong action, such as refunding the wrong purchase, can cause irreversible task failure and must be intercepted before execution. Such failures may not appear in every single run, but can emerge across repeated trials, making reliability across steps and trials critical. However, ensuring agentic reliability is challenging: even frontier LLMs struggle to explain why an action may be wrong, especially in long, intertwined trajectories governed by domain-specific policies. Much recent work relies on prompt-based critique agents, while optimization-based methods lack a systematic way to produce rich verification rationales for training. We address this gap with CAST, a critique-aware training framework that converts sparse task outcomes into action-level supervision for critique learning and policy

translated_title: CAST：面向训练可靠长程工具调用智能体的批判感知监督
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体正越来越多地被部署在长程、交互式和有状态的环境中。在这些环境中，单个错误动作（例如退款了错误的购买订单）可能导致不可逆的任务失败，必须在执行前被拦截。这类失败可能不会在每次运行中都出现，但可能在多次重复试验中显现，因此跨步骤和跨试验的可靠性至关重要。然而，确保智能体的可靠性极具挑战性：即使是最前沿的大语言模型也难以解释某个动作为什么可能是错误的，尤其是在由特定领域策略支配的漫长且相互交织的轨迹中。许多近期工作依赖于基于提示的批判智能体，而基于优化的方法则缺乏系统性的方式来生成丰富的验证理据用于训练。我们通过 CAST 来弥补这一空白——这是一个批判感知的训练框架，它将稀疏的任务结果转化为动作级别的监督信号，用于批判学习和策略……
tldr: CAST 提出了一种批判感知的训练框架，通过将稀疏的任务结果转化为动作级别的监督信号来训练可靠的长程工具调用智能体，使其能够在错误动作造成不可逆失败之前进行拦截。
en_tdlr: CAST is a critique-aware training framework that converts sparse task outcomes into action-level supervision, enabling reliable long-horizon tool-calling agents to intercept erroneous actions before irreversible failure occurs.
